question: Which of the following dance forms depicts the anguish of women whose partners are gone from home?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Biraha**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Biraha dance **and its offshoot, the Bidesia, are well-liked forms of **entertainment in rural Bihar.**
 
• It portrays the **suffering of women** whose partners have left the house.
 
• On the other side, only men who also play **female characters** can do this kind of **dancing.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Matki:**

 
 
• **The Malwa region of Madhya Pradesh**, India, is where the matki dance is most frequently practiced.
 
• Women execute this **solo dance** on special occasions.
 
 
 
• **Alkap:**
 
 
• Alkap is a traditional **village dance-drama **that is performed in the **Rajmahal Hills of Jharkhand and the Rajshahi, Murshidabad, and Malda regions of West Bengal.**
 
• **Ten to twelve dancers** in groups, with one or two gayens, perform it.
 
• The troops perform **comic sketches **known as kap interspersed with **well-known folktales and myths.**
 
 
 
• **Paika:**
 
 
• Popular in** Odisha **is the** martial folk dance** known as paika.
 
• Paika is** lengthy spears.**
 
• To show off their skills and agility, the dancers perform in infantry-like formations while armed with** wooden spears and shields.**
